verdict.rationale: Cerebras is fundamentally an API-first inference platform: the docs show the API covers chat, streaming, structured outputs, tool calling, batch processing, dedicated endpoints, and model selection — essentially all functionality, with the Cloud Console playground presented as an optional UI convenience rather than the primary interface. This strongly supports full API parity with UI capabilities. missing for 10: no explicit feature-parity statement or independent confirmation that every UI-console action (e.g. dedicated endpoint provisioning, billing management) is also API-accessible, and no public OpenAPI spec was found (probe 404s) to verify completeness.
